source: Lemegeton book 1 (Goetia), Peterson's transcription of BL Sloane MS 3825, from goetia_entries_raw.json; hand annotation with spelling modernised in phrase fields, archaic grammar kept.

entries.name: Bael
appearance: in divers shapes, sometimes like a cat
sometimes like a toad
sometimes like a man
sometimes in all these forms at once
manner: speaketh very hoarsely
offices: maketh men go invisible
conditions: his character is to be worn as a lamen before him who calleth him forth, or else he will not do you homage
entries.seal_clause: This is his character, which is to be worn as a lamen before him who calleth him forth, or else he will not do you homage.

entries.name: Agares
entries.location: under the power of the East
appearance: in the form of a fair old man riding upon a crocodile, carrying a goshawk on his fist
manner: cometh up very mildly
offices: maketh them run that stand still
fetcheth back the runaways
teacheth all languages or tongues presently
destroyeth dignities, both supernatural and temporal
causeth earthquakes
conditions: his seal or character is to be worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: This is his seal or character, which is to be worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Vassago
nature: of the same nature as Agares
offices: declareth things past and to come
discovereth all things hidden or lost
entries.seal_clause: This is his seal.

entries.name: Gamigin
appearance: in the form of a little horse or ass
entries.transformation: then into human shape he putteth himself at the request of the master
manner: speaketh with a hoarse voice
offices: teacheth all liberal sciences
giveth an account of the dead souls of them that die in sin
conditions: his seal is to be worn by the magician when he invocateth
entries.seal_clause: This is his seal, which is to be worn by the magician when he invocateth.

entries.name: Marbas
appearance: at first in the form of a great lion
entries.transformation: afterwards putteth on human shape at the request of the master
offices: answereth truly of things hidden or secret
causeth diseases
cureth them again
giveth great wisdom and knowledge in mechanical arts
changeth men into other shapes
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this.

entries.name: Valefar
nature: tempteth those he is familiar with to steal
appearance: in the form of a lion with a man's head, lowering
conditions: his seal is to be worn constantly if you have his familiarity, else not
entries.seal_clause: This is his seal, to wear constantly if you have his familiarity, else not.

entries.name: Amon
appearance: at first like a wolf with a serpent's tail, vomiting out of his mouth flames of fire
entries.transformation: at the command of the magician he putteth on the shape of a man, with dog's teeth beset in a head like a raven, or in a raven's head
offices: telleth all things past and to come
procureth love
reconcileth controversies between friends and foes
conditions: his seal is to be worn as aforesaid
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus, which is to be worn as aforesaid.

entries.name: Barbatos
entries.order_extra: of which some part beareth rule still
manner: appeareth with four noble kings and their companions in great troops
offices: giveth the understanding of the singing of birds, the voice of other creatures and the barking of dogs
breaketh hidden treasures open that have been laid by the enchantment of magicians
knoweth all things past and to come
reconcileth friends and those that are in power
conditions: his seal of obedience is to be worn before you
other: appeareth when the Sun is in [Sagittarius] (sign left blank in the manuscript)
entries.seal_clause: His seal of obedience is this, which wear before you.

entries.name: Paimon
entries.legions_note: one part of them of the order of Angels and the other of Potestates; other spirits of the order of Potestates in his host are 25 legions, not always with him unless the magician compelleth them
entries.location: is to be observed towards the North-west
appearance: in the form of a man sitting on a dromedary, with a crown most glorious on his head
manner: there goeth before him a host of spirits like men with trumpets and well-sounding cymbals and all other sorts of musical instruments
hath a great voice
roareth at his first coming
his speech is such as the magician cannot well understand unless he compelleth him
if called alone, there will attend him two kings called Bebal and Abalam
offices: teacheth all arts and sciences and other secret things
discovereth what the earth is and what holdeth it up in the waters
telleth what the wind is or where it is, or any other thing you desire to know
giveth dignity and confirmeth the same
bindeth or maketh a man subject to the magician if he desireth it
giveth good familiars, and such as can teach all arts
conditions: if you call this spirit Paimon alone you must make some offering to him
the magician must compel him before his speech can be understood
entries.seal_clause: This is his character.

entries.name: Buer
appearance: in [Sagittarius], that is his shape (sign left blank in the manuscript)
offices: teacheth philosophy, both moral and natural
teacheth the logical arts
teacheth the virtues of all herbs and plants
healeth all distempers in man
giveth good familiars
conditions: his seal of obedience you must wear when you call him to appearance
other: appeareth when the Sun is there [in Sagittarius] (sign left blank in the manuscript)
entries.seal_clause: This is his seal of obedience, which you must wear when you call him to appearance.

entries.name: Gusoin
appearance: like a Xenophilus [zenophali]
offices: telleth of all things past, present and to come
sheweth the meaning of all questions you can ask
reconcileth friends
giveth honour and dignity to any
conditions: his seal is to be worn as aforesaid
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which wear as aforesaid.

entries.name: Sitri
appearance: at first with a leopard's face and wings as a griffin
entries.transformation: afterwards at the command of the exorcist he putteth on a human shape very beautiful
offices: inflameth men with women's love and women with men's love
causeth them to show themselves naked, if it be desired
conditions: his seal is to be worn
entries.seal_clause: His seal to be worn is this.

entries.name: Beleth
nature: very furious at his first appearance
appearance: riding on a pale horse
manner: with trumpets and all other kinds of musical instruments playing before him
kings and princes attend him and do homage to him
offices: causeth all the love that possibly may be, both of men and women, till the master exorcist hath had his mind fulfilled
conditions: whilst the exorcist allayeth his courage he must hold a hazel stick in his hand, stretched forth towards the South and East quarters
make a triangle without the circle and command him into it by the virtue of the bonds and chains of spirits hereafter following
if he do not come into the triangle by your threats, rehearse the bonds and chains before him, and then he will yield obedience and come into it and do what he is commanded
the exorcist must receive him courteously and do homage to him, because he is a great king, as the kings and princes that attend him do
you must always have a silver ring on the middle finger of the left hand, held against your face, as they do for Amaymon
his noble seal is to be worn before you in the time of working
entries.seal_clause: His noble seal is this, which is to be worn before you in the time of working.

entries.name: Leraye
appearance: in the likeness of an archer, clad in green, carrying a bow and quiver
offices: causeth all great battles and contests
causeth the wounds to putrefy that are made with arrows by archers
other: this belongeth to [Sagittarius] (sign left blank in the manuscript)
entries.seal_clause: His seal of obedience is this.

entries.name: Eligor
appearance: in the form of a goodly knight carrying a lance, an ensign and a serpent
offices: discovereth hidden things
knoweth things to come
knoweth of wars and how the soldiers will and shall meet
causeth the love of lords and great persons
conditions: wear his seal, or else he will not appear nor obey you
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which wear, or else he will not appear nor obey you.

entries.name: Zepar
appearance: in red apparel and armed like a soldier
offices: causeth women to love men and bringeth them together in love
maketh them barren
conditions: he obeyeth his seal when he seeth it
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which he obeyeth when he seeth it.

entries.name: Botis
appearance: at the first show in the form of an ugly viper
entries.transformation: then at the command of the magician he putteth on human shape, with great teeth and two horns, carrying a sharp bright sword in his hand
offices: telleth of all things past and to come
reconcileth friends and foes
conditions: he obeyeth his seal when he seeth it
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, that he obeyeth when he seeth it.

entries.name: Bathin
appearance: like a strong man with the tail of a serpent, sitting on a pale-coloured horse
offices: knoweth the virtues of herbs and precious stones
transporteth men suddenly from one country into another
conditions: his seal is to be made thus and worn before you
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus to be made and to be worn before you.

entries.name: Saleos
appearance: in the form of a gallant soldier riding on a crocodile, with a duke's crown on his head
manner: appeareth peaceably
offices: causeth the love of women to men and men to women
conditions: his seal must be worn before you
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which must be worn before you.

entries.name: Purson
entries.legions_note: partly of the order of Virtues and partly of the order of Thrones
appearance: commonly like a man with a lion's face, carrying a cruel viper in his hand and riding on a bear
entries.transformation: can take a body either human or aerial
manner: going before him are many trumpets sounding
offices: knoweth hidden things
discovereth treasures
telleth all things present, past and to come
answereth truly of all earthly things, both secret and divine
answereth truly of the creation of the world
bringeth forth good familiars
conditions: his mark or seal, which he oweth obedience to, must be worn by the exorcist in the time of action
entries.seal_clause: His mark or seal is this, which he oweth obedience to, and which must be worn by the exorcist in the time of action.

entries.name: Morax
appearance: like a great bull with a man's face
offices: maketh men very knowing in astronomy and all the other liberal sciences
giveth good familiars, and very wise, which know the virtues of herbs and precious stones
conditions: his seal is to be made thus and worn as aforesaid
entries.seal_clause: His seal is to be made thus and worn as aforesaid.

entries.name: Ipos
appearance: in the form of an angel with a lion's head, goose's feet and a hare's tail
offices: knoweth things past and to come
maketh men witty and bold
conditions: his seal or character must be worn as a lamen before you
entries.seal_clause: His seal or character is this, which must be worn as a lamen before you.

entries.name: Aim
appearance: in the form of a very handsome man in body, but with three heads, the first like a serpent, the second like a man with two stars in his forehead, the third like a cat; he rideth on a viper, carrying a firebrand burning in his hand
offices: setteth cities, castles and great places on fire
maketh one witty in all manner of ways
giveth true answers to privy matters
conditions: his seal is to be made thus and worn as a lamen before you
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus to be made, and worn as a lamen before you.

entries.name: Naberius
appearance: in the form of a black crow, fluttering about the circle
manner: when he speaketh it is with a hoarse voice
offices: maketh men cunning in all arts and sciences, but especially in the art of rhetoric
restoreth lost dignity and honours
conditions: his seal must be worn
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which must be worn.

entries.name: Glasya Labolas
appearance: in the form of a dog with wings like a griffin
offices: teacheth all arts in an instant
is an author of bloodshed and manslaughter
telleth all things past and to come, if desired
causeth love of friends and foes
maketh a man go invisible
conditions: his seal is to be worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, the which wear as a lamen.

entries.name: Bune
appearance: in the form of a dragon with three heads, one like a dog, the other like a griffin, the third like a man
manner: speaketh with a high and comely voice
offices: changeth the places of the dead
causeth those spirits that are under him to gather together upon their sepulchres
giveth riches to a man
maketh him wise and eloquent
giveth true answers to your demands
conditions: he oweth obedience to his seal
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which he oweth obedience to.

entries.name: Ronove
appearance: in the form of a monster
offices: teacheth the art of rhetoric very well
giveth good servants
giveth knowledge of tongues
giveth favour of friends and foes
other: rank stated only after the offices
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this.

entries.name: Berith
nature: a great liar and not to be trusted much
appearance: like a soldier with red clothing, riding on a red horse, with a crown of gold upon his head
manner: speaketh with a very clear and subtle voice
offices: giveth true answers of things past, present and to come
turneth all metals into gold
giveth dignities and confirmeth them to men
conditions: you must use a ring, as is before spoken of Beleth, in calling him forth
his seal must be worn as a lamen
other: in order as Solomon bound them
hath two other names given to him by men of latter times, viz. Beal and Bolfry
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which must be worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Astaroth
appearance: in the form of an unbeautiful angel, riding on an infernal-like dragon, and carrying in his right hand a viper
offices: giveth true answers of things present, past and to come
discovereth all secrets
declareth willingly how the spirits fell, if desired, and the reason of his own fall
maketh men wonderful knowing in all liberal sciences
conditions: you must not let him come too near you, lest he do you damage by his stinking breath
the exorcist must hold the magical ring near to his face, and that will defend him
wear his seal as a lamen before you, or else he will not obey you
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which wear as a lamen before you, or else he will not obey you.

entries.name: Forneus
entries.legions_note: partly of the order of Thrones and partly of Angels
appearance: in the form of a great sea monster
offices: teacheth and maketh men wonderful knowing in the art of rhetoric
causeth men to have a good name
causeth men to have the understanding of tongues
maketh men to be beloved of their foes as well as of their friends
conditions: his seal is to be made and worn as aforesaid
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, to be made and worn as aforesaid.

entries.name: Foras
appearance: in the form of a strong man, in human shape
offices: giveth men the understanding how they may know the virtues of all herbs and precious stones
teacheth the art of logic and ethics in all their parts, if desired
maketh men invisible
maketh men witty and eloquent
maketh men to live long
discovereth treasures
recovereth things lost
conditions: his seal or character is to be made thus and worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal or character is thus to be made and worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Asmoday
entries.location: the first and chiefest under the power of Amaymon
appearance: with three heads, whereof the first is like a bull, the second like a man, the third like a ram; with a serpent's tail, belching or vomiting up flames of fire out of his mouth; his feet are webbed like a goose; he sitteth on an infernal dragon, carrying a lance and a flag in his hands
manner: goeth before all others
by and by he will bow down to the ground
offices: giveth the ring of virtues
teacheth the art of arithmetic, geometry, astronomy and all handicrafts absolutely
giveth full and true answers to your demands
maketh a man invisible
showeth the place where treasures lie
guardeth it if it be among the legions of Amaymon
conditions: when the exorcist hath a mind to call him, let it be abroad
let him stand on his feet all the time of action with his cap off, for if it be on, Amaymon will deceive him and cause all his doings to be bewrayed
as soon as the exorcist seeth Asmoday in the shape aforesaid, he shall call him by his name, saying 'Thou art Asmoday', and he will not deny it
his seal is to be made thus and worn as a lamen before thee on your breast
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus, to be made and worn as a lamen before thee on your breast.

entries.name: Gaap
appearance: in a human shape
manner: going before four great and mighty kings, as if he were a guide to conduct them along in their way
offices: maketh men knowing in philosophy and all the liberal sciences
causeth love or hatred
maketh men insensible
teacheth how to consecrate those things that belong to the dominion of Amaymon his king
delivereth familiars out of the custody of other magicians
answereth truly and perfectly of things past, present and to come
carrieth and recarrieth things most speedily from one kingdom to another at the will and pleasure of the exorcist
conditions: his seal is to be made thus and worn as a lamen
other: appeareth when the Sun is in some of the southern signs
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus to be made and to be worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Furtur
nature: never speaketh truth except he be compelled
appearance: in the form of a hart with a fiery tail
entries.transformation: being compelled within a triangle, he will take upon himself the form of an angel, being bidden
manner: speaketh with a hoarse voice
offices: will willingly make love between man and wife
raiseth thunder, lightnings, blasts and great tempestuous storms
giveth true answers both of secret and divine things, if commanded
conditions: he must be compelled or brought up within a triangle, or he will not speak truth
his seal is to be worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which is to be worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Marchosias
entries.order_extra: he told his chief master, which was Solomon, that after 1200 years he had hopes to return to the seventh throne
nature: is very faithful to the exorcist in doing his business
appearance: at first in the form of a wolf, having griffin's wings and a serpent's tail, vomiting up fire out of his mouth
entries.transformation: afterwards at the command of the exorcist he putteth on the shape of a man
offices: giveth true answers to all questions
conditions: his seal is to be made and worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus, to be made and worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Stolas
appearance: in the shape of a night raven, at first before the exorcist
entries.transformation: afterwards he taketh the image of a man
offices: teacheth the art of astronomy
teacheth the virtues of herbs and precious stones
conditions: his seal is to be made and worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus to be made and worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Phoenix
entries.order_extra: hath hopes to return to the seventh throne after 1200 years more, as he said to Solomon
nature: will be willing to do your request
appearance: like the bird Phoenix
entries.transformation: by and by the exorcist must bid him put on human shape
manner: having a child's voice
singeth many sweet notes before the exorcist
offices: speaketh marvellously of all wonderful sciences
is a good and excellent poet
conditions: the exorcist must not regard his sweet notes, but by and by must bid him put on human shape
his seal is to be made and worn
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus to be made and worn.

entries.name: Halphas
appearance: in the form of a stork [dove]
manner: speaketh with a hoarse voice
offices: buildeth up towers [towns]
furnisheth them with ammunition and weapons
sendeth men of war to places appointed
conditions: his seal is to be made and worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus to be made and worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Malphas
appearance: at first in the form like a crow [raven]
entries.transformation: afterwards will put on a human shape at the request of the exorcist
manner: speaketh with a hoarse voice
offices: buildeth houses and high towers
bringeth quickly artificers together from all places of the world
destroyeth the enemies' desires or thoughts and all that they have done
giveth good familiars
conditions: if you make any sacrifices to him he will receive it kindly and willingly, but he will deceive him that doth it
his seal is to be made and worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus to be made and worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Raum
appearance: at first in the form of a crow
entries.transformation: afterwards at the command of the exorcist he putteth on human shape
offices: stealeth treasures out of kings' houses and carrieth it where he is commanded
destroyeth cities
destroyeth the dignities of men
telleth all things past, and what is, and what will be
causeth love between friends and foes
conditions: his seal is to be made and worn as a lamen before you
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus, which make and wear as a lamen before you.

entries.name: Focalor
entries.order_extra: hath hopes to return to the seventh throne after 1000 years
appearance: in the form of a man with griffin's wings
offices: killeth men
drowneth them in the waters
overthroweth ships of war
hath power over both winds and seas
conditions: he will not hurt any man or thing if he be commanded to the contrary by the exorcist
his seal must be worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which must be worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Vepar
appearance: like a mermaid
offices: guideth the waters and ships laden with armour thereon
at the request of the exorcist causeth the seas to be rough and stormy
causeth the seas to appear full of ships
causeth men to die in three days by putrefying their sores and wounds and causing worms in them to breed
conditions: his seal is to be made and worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus to be made and worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Sabnach
appearance: in the form of an armed soldier with a lion's head, riding on a pale-coloured horse
offices: buildeth high towers, castles and cities
furnisheth them with armour
afflicteth men several days with wounds and rotten sores full of worms
giveth good familiars at the command of the exorcist
conditions: his seal is to be made and worn as a lamen
other: in order as Solomon commanded them into the brazen vessel
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus to be made and worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Shax
appearance: in the form of a stock dove
manner: speaketh with a hoarse and subtle voice
offices: taketh away the sight, hearing and understanding of any man or woman at the command of the exorcist
stealeth money out of kings' houses and carrieth it again in 1200 years, if commanded
fetcheth horses or any thing at the request of the exorcist
discovereth all things that are hidden and not kept by wicked spirits
giveth good familiars sometimes
conditions: he must be commanded into a triangle first, or else he will deceive the exorcist and tell you many lies
his seal is to be made and worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus to be made and worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Vine
appearance: in the form of a lion riding on a black horse, with a viper in his hand
offices: discovereth things hidden
discovereth witches
discovereth things present, past and to come
at the command of the exorcist buildeth towers
throweth down great stone walls
maketh waters rough with storms
conditions: his seal is to be made and worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which make and wear as a lamen.

entries.name: Bifrons
appearance: in the form of a monster at first
entries.transformation: after a while at the command of the exorcist he putteth on the shape of a man
offices: maketh one knowing in astrology and geometry and other arts and sciences
teacheth the virtues of all herbs, precious stones and woods
changeth the dead bodies and putteth them into one another's places
lighteth candles seemingly upon the graves of the dead
conditions: he will own and submit unto his seal
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which he will own and submit unto.

entries.name: Vual
appearance: in the form of a mighty dromedary at first
entries.transformation: after a while he putteth on human shape
manner: speaketh in the Egyptian tongue, but not perfectly
offices: procureth the love of women
telleth things past, present and to come
procureth friendship between friends and foes
conditions: his seal is to be made and worn as a lamen before you
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus to be made and worn as a lamen before you.

entries.name: Haagenti
appearance: in the form of a mighty bull with griffin's wings at first
entries.transformation: afterwards at the command of the exorcist he putteth on human shape
offices: maketh men wise
instructeth them in divers things
transmuteth all metals into gold
changeth wine into water and water into wine
conditions: his seal is to be made and worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus made, and to be worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Procel
entries.order_extra: as he declared to Solomon, before his fall
appearance: in the form of an angel
manner: speaketh somewhat mystically of hidden things
offices: teacheth the art of geometry and the liberal sciences
at the command of the exorcist maketh great noises like the running of great waters, although there be none
warmeth waters
distempereth baths
conditions: his character or mark is to be made thus and worn as a lamen before you
entries.seal_clause: His character or mark is thus to be made and worn as a lamen before you.

entries.name: Furcas
appearance: in the form and similitude of a cruel old man with a long beard and a hoary head, sitting on a pale-coloured horse, with a sharp weapon in his hand
offices: teacheth the art of philosophy, astronomy, rhetoric, logic, chiromancy and pyromancy in all their parts perfectly
conditions: his seal or mark is to be made and worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal or mark is this, which make and wear as a lamen.

entries.name: Balam
appearance: with three heads, the first like a bull's, the second like a man's, the third like a ram's head; he hath a serpent's tail and flaming eyes; riding upon a furious bear, carrying a goshawk on his fist
manner: speaketh with a hoarse voice
offices: giveth true answers of things past, present and to come
maketh men to go invisible
maketh men witty
conditions: his seal is to be made and worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus to be made and to be worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Alloces
appearance: in the form of a soldier riding on a great horse; his face is like a lion's, very red, having flaming eyes
manner: his speech is hoarse and very big
offices: teacheth the art of astronomy and all the liberal sciences
bringeth good familiars
conditions: his seal is to be made and worn
entries.seal_clause: His seal is thus made, and is to be worn.

entries.name: Caim
appearance: at first in the form of a bird called a thrush
entries.transformation: after a while he putteth on the shape of a man, carrying in his hand a sharp sword
manner: seemeth to answer in burning ashes
offices: giveth men the understanding of all birds, lowing of bullocks, barking of dogs and other creatures
giveth men the understanding of the noise of waters
giveth very true answers of things to come
conditions: his seal is to be worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which wear as a lamen.

entries.name: Murmur
entries.order: partly of the order of Thrones and partly of Angels
appearance: in the form of a soldier riding on a griffin, with a duke's crown on his head
manner: there goeth before him two of his ministers with great trumpets sounding
offices: teacheth philosophy perfectly
constraineth souls deceased to come before the exorcist to answer those things that he shall ask them, if he desireth
conditions: his seal is to be worn as a lamen
entries.seal_clause: His seal is this, which is to be worn as a lamen.

entries.name: Orobas
appearance: at first like a horse
entries.transformation: afterwards at the command of the exorcist he putteth on the image of a man
offices: discovereth all things past, present and to come
giveth dignities and prelacies
giveth the favour of friends and foes
giveth true answers of divinity and of the creation of the world
will not suffer the exorcist to be tempted by any spirit
conditions: his seal must be made and worn as a lamen

notes: words: whitespace tokens of the manuscript text with Peterson's [..] and <..> insertions and footnote markers removed; entry 1 includes its separate seal_formula sentence; entry 72's seal_formula ('This is based on Agrippa's') is an editorial note and is not counted.
